subject: CSA/CAIQ: deployment-zone control mapping and evidence (zone ownership clarifications)
messages:
From: Ethan Clary <ethan.clary@sentinelcloud.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: security@sentinelcloud.com
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: CSA/CAIQ mapping for deployment zones — evidence request

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of SentinelCloud's CSA assessment we need CAIQ control mappings and evidence focused on how Redwood isolates and governs deployment zones (multi-tenant hosted + dedicated VPCs). Specifically, the assessor has asked for: 

- A control-to-evidence crosswalk for relevant CAIQ control IDs that touch network segregation, tenant isolation, and key management (please map to the CAIQ control IDs you reference).
- Architecture diagram showing zone boundaries (VPCs/subnets, bastions, NATs, peering).
- Sample VPC flow logs or equivalent demonstrating traffic restrictions between customer zones and shared infra.
- The owner and runbook for zone segmentation (who performs changes, approval flow).
- KMS key rotation policy and an example rotation event for the service keys used in customer-specific deployments.

Deadline: the assessor requested the first package within five business days if possible (we can be flexible by a couple days). If any items are sensitive, please mark them and we can arrange an NDA/secure upload.

Can you confirm whether you can provide an initial bundle and who on your side will be the point of contact?

Thanks,
Ethan
Ethan Clary
Security Assessment Lead | SentinelCloud Partners
security@sentinelcloud.com

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: Ethan Clary <ethan.clary@sentinelcloud.com>
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CSA/CAIQ mapping for deployment zones — evidence request

Ethan,

Appreciate the clear ask — we can get you an initial package within the five-business-day window. I've looped in Mina (security/compliance) and Vanessa (platform ops) who will own the artifacts and owner confirmations. High-level plan: 

- Mina: will produce the CAIQ control crosswalk and an evidence index referencing the attached files.
- Vanessa: will pull the architecture diagram, flow log samples (redacted), and the zone segmentation runbook; she'll also include the change approval workflow.
- I'll handle the intake, mark any artifacts that need an NDA, and confirm HubSpot/deal metadata so we keep everything traceable.

Requested attachments we'll include in the first bundle: vpc-architecture-diagram.pdf, zone-segmentation-runbook.md, kv-kms-rotation.pdf (rotation policy + example), flowlogs-sample.csv. If those look good I'll ask Mina/Vanessa to start collating.

Do you have a preferred secure upload method? We can use the Drive share link (private, link-only) or arrange a Vault transfer if you prefer. Also tell us whether the assessor needs logs from a particular time window (7/30–8/06 is easiest for us).

> Thanks for taking this on. As part of SentinelCloud's CSA assessment we need CAIQ control mappings and evidence focused on how Redwood isolates and governs deployment zones...

Hi Ethan — thanks, Rishi. Quick note from my side on the crosswalk and artifacts we'll produce: 

1) CAIQ mapping (deliverable: caiq-crosswalk.xlsx)
   - Map controls that primarily matter for zone isolation: NET-1, NET-2, INF-3, ID-1 (example names; we'll use the exact CAIQ IDs in the sheet).
   - For each control: evidence filename, internal control owner, short justification text, and maturity notes.

2) Evidence files (deliverables attached to this thread and placed on the Drive link):
   - vpc-architecture-diagram.pdf — high-level and zoomed views with tenant boundaries labeled.
   - zone-segmentation-runbook.md — owner, approval steps, change windows, rollback.
   - flowlogs-sample.csv — redacted samples demonstrating deny/allow patterns between zones (we will redact external IPs).
   - kv-kms-rotation.pdf — rotation policy + one recent rotation event export (audit trail).

3) Additional artifacts we can provide on request: host-based firewall baseline, netacl change tickets (Jira IDs), and a short attestation from Platform Security.

Notes/asks: please confirm the sample window you'd like (our default is the week of 2027-07-30 to 2027-08-05). Also let us know if the assessor requires raw logs vs. summarized CSVs (we will redact any customer-identifying fields before sharing). 

Uploading now to the Drive folder Rishi created; marking the rotation docs as sensitive (requires link-only access).

Mina Haddad
Senior Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

From: Ethan Clary <ethan.clary@sentinelcloud.com>

Thanks Rishi / Mina — this looks great and useful. A couple quick clarifications from the assessor team: 

- Please provide the flowlog sample for the 2027-07-30 to 2027-08-05 window (CSV is fine, thank you for redactions).
- For the KMS rotation evidence, can you include a single rotation event with timestamps and the audit entry showing the operator identity (redact any internal accounts but show the role)?
- The assessor also wants a one-paragraph retention statement describing how long logs and runbooks are retained and where archive copies live.

Secure upload: the Drive link is fine if set to link-only and shared with security@sentinelcloud.com. Could you add a short README in the folder that maps filenames to CAIQ IDs? That will speed the assessor review.

If you can get the initial bundle uploaded by EOD Friday (2027-08-06) that would keep us on track. We'll follow up with any clarification requests after initial review.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we know this is a dense set.

Best,
Ethan
